patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: One if by land, two if by sea — and then the horse decided on a third option. Honestly I'm more upset about not finishing the ride than about the shoulder.
clinical.presentationShort: 49yo M — fell ~8ft from a horse onto right shoulder. Deformity over mid-clavicle, NV intact, no head strike, no LOC.
clinical.presentationLong: 49-year-old male who fell about eight feet from a horse onto his right shoulder, with an obvious deformity over the mid-clavicle; no head strike, no loss of consciousness, neurovascularly intact.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → shoulder X-ray, broad arm sling, orthopaedic follow-up
diagnosis.why: One X-ray and a sling makes this a true ESI 4. Skin tenting or any neurovascular change would escalate it immediately — he has neither.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 49-year-old man in colonial Paul Revere costume with a tricorn hat in his lap, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting upright supporting his right elbow with his left hand, right shoulder dropped
signs: right shoulder visibly dropped and lower than the left
a bump over the right collarbone
a tricorn hat resting on his lap
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: well and stable, in moderate pain
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 49-year-old man in a full colonial Paul Revere costume - a deep blue frock coat with large brass buttons, a cream waistcoat, a white cravat at the throat, knee breeches and buckled shoes - WEARING a black tricorn hat on his head, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright with his LEFT hand gripping his own RIGHT SHOULDER - the hand is on the shoulder itself, NOT on the chest and NOT on the elbow - while his right arm hangs down and the right shoulder sits visibly lower than the left. Expression: rueful and mildly outraged. Clearly visible: a black tricorn hat worn on the head; the left hand gripping the right shoulder; the right shoulder visibly dropped lower than the left with a bump over the right collarbone; a colonial blue frock coat. Overall: well and stable, in moderate pain. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
